questions.question: It was only when I got to the airport that I realized my passport had expired. By the time I returned home, it was already too late to renew it. So, _______________ did I have a valid passport for my trip.
options: I hadn't
I hadn't been able to get one
I hadn't got around to renewing it yet
I hadn't had time to renew it

questions.question: The company's profits have increased significantly over the past year, and _______________ is expected to continue in the coming months.
options: it will be a major challenge for the management team
the board of directors has been warned about potential risks
the financial analysts are predicting further growth
the shareholders are likely to benefit from increased dividends
questions.answer: the financial analysts are predicting further growth

questions.question: The new policy requires that all employees _______________ their work by the end of each day, so that it can be reviewed and approved by management.
options: will have to
must
should
have to

questions.question: The researcher's findings suggested that the new treatment was _______________ effective in reducing symptoms of depression.
options: completely ineffective
only slightly more effective than the current treatment
significantly more effective, but with some side effects
far more effective than any other treatment available
questions.answer: significantly more effective, but with some side effects

questions.question: The company's CEO emphasized that the decision to relocate was _______________ by a thorough analysis of market trends and customer feedback.
options: made in haste
taken without consulting other stakeholders
influenced solely by financial considerations
fully justified by the data
